entities.summary:
Northeast Italy is one of the five official statistical regions of Italy used by the National Institute of Statistics (ISTAT), a first level NUTS region and a European Parliament constituency. Northeast encompasses four of the country's 20 regions:Emilia-Romagna
Friuli-Venezia Giulia
Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol
Veneto
